properties.verseOrder: v1 v2 v3 v4 v5 v6

verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
WULIRA mu luyoogaano
Eddoboozi lya Yesu,
Bw'akuyita omunaku
Okumugoberera.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Nga basuula obutimba
Mu nnyanja-abatume be,
Yabayita ng'abagamba
Bw'ati:Muyite nange.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Bo ne balekawo mangu
Obutimba,ne bajja,
Bwe baawulira-eddoboozi
Erya Yesu ntiMujje.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Bw'atyo Yesu bw'atuyita
Okuleka-ebyonoono,
Era n'okutambulanga
Mu makubo g'obulamu-.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Mu ssanyu era mu nnaku,
Mu ndwadde ne mu bulamu-;
Tukyawulira-eddoboozi
Ly'Omulokozi waffe.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Mwana wange tosuulanga
Bye nkugabira buwa,
Laba bwe nnafiirira ggwe,
Mpa-omutima gwo gwonna
